verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions an audit log, change history, or any record of who changed the cap table and when. Several features are related but different and earn no credit under the adjacent-feature rule: documents smart-linked to the cap table, board consents built into workflows, award agreements tied to board consents, and an auto-collected data room. None of them shows a log capturing who made each change, what changed, when, and under what authorization.
